m1.typescript: m1 the hook script blocks pushes deletes and piped downloads in any spelling

e1.typescript: e1 edits to protected paths stop with exit two and a reason

e2.typescript: e2 an event it cannot read blocks the call and other tools are left alone

e3.typescript: e3 the hook is registered for every tool it guards and found through the plugin root

e4.typescript: e4 the skills set the right invocation rules and approve only patterns

e5.typescript: e5 the subagent only reads is bounded and uses only fields a plugin agent honours

e6.typescript: e6 the manifest names the plugin and pins its dependency to patch updates

e7.typescript: e7 the team settings register the marketplace the enabled plugin comes from

wrong-push-prefix.defect: refuses git push only when push is the first word after git, so git -C . push passes

wrong-rm-literal.defect: refuses only the exact flag spelling -rf

wrong-pipe-shell-allowed.defect: lets a download be piped into a shell

wrong-edit-exit-one.defect: exits 1 on a protected path, which does not block the call

wrong-no-reason.defect: blocks a protected path without saying why

wrong-bad-json-allowed.defect: lets a call through when the event cannot be read

wrong-matcher-bash-only.defect: registers the hook for Bash only, so edits are not guarded

wrong-relative-path.defect: finds the script by a path relative to the working directory instead of the plugin root

wrong-publish-auto.defect: lets Claude start the publish skill on its own

wrong-bare-bash.defect: pre-approves every shell command for the publish skill

wrong-agent-writes.defect: gives the reviewer the Edit tool

wrong-agent-bypass.defect: sets a permission mode that a plugin agent ignores

wrong-dependency-unpinned.defect: depends on secrets-vault with no version range

wrong-marketplace-mismatch.defect: enables the plugin from a marketplace that the file does not register
